name: Stella Maris College
summary: Stella Maris College is a Catholic minority college for women founded on 15 August 1947 and run by the Franciscan Missionaries of Mary. It began with 32 students in Santhome and moved in 1960 to 'The Cloisters' on Cathedral Road. It is autonomous, affiliated to the University of Madras and partly residential. Programmes run in an aided section and a self-financing section (Shift II, 12:55–5:30 pm); students are selected purely on merit.
